implementation: Removed the WS05 Emscripten-only fixed 1024x768 logical resolution while preserving accepted browser window-mode/cursor behavior.

Established viewport-native logical dimensions from visualViewport/window before SDL/UI initialization and on later resize/fullscreen changes, preventing the old 4:3 presentation rectangle from feeding back as the native render target.
Separated logical game/UI/picking coordinates from physical WebGL backing pixels and bounded renderScale to 1.0-2.0 with performance/balanced/sharp/native quality modes and pixel budgets.
Refreshed RHIDeviceGL physical drawable dimensions from the actual Emscripten canvas before drawing so GL viewport/scissor density follows the backing store rather than stale startup dimensions.
Published runtime CSS/viewport/logical/backing/drawingBuffer/DPR/renderScale, FPS/frame-time, WASM/JS memory estimate and texture/mipmap telemetry in window.__OLDKO_RENDER_METRICS__.
Kept genuine KO assets and existing D3D sampler/mipmap authority; no unsourced HD replacement and no global filter override was introduced.

Exact GPU VRAM usage is not reliably exposed by WebGL; renderTargetsEstimateBytes is explicitly a minimum color+depth estimate, not invented VRAM telemetry.

blockers.detail: P2-03 is a native source change. No old JS/WASM/data artifact can prove it. P2-00 must build the exact reconciled client before READY_FOR_INTEGRATION can be asserted.
The P2-02 loader/canvas handoff was absent when checked, so final presentation/backing-store composition is not pinned yet.
The requested same-state before/after screenshots plus true drawingBuffer resolution, FPS/frame-time and memory measurements for all 12 resolution/scale/mode cases await the fresh P2-00 candidate.

notes: The default sharp mode caps DPR at 1.5 and 4.7M backing pixels; native is opt-in and capped at DPR 2.0/8.3M to avoid forcing maximum DPR on every device.
P2-10 handoff explicitly requests one P2-03 viewport-to-game transform, matching this contract.
